usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the binary search tree in `main.wj`. It builds and runs with `wj run --compiled`.

I tested it on my own 16-line input, not your two examples. It covered `insert`, `dup`, `contains`, `delete` (including a two-child node), `missing`, `inorder`, `height`, `min` and `max`, and the output matched what I expected. I did not run your two examples or the empty-tree cases (`<empty>`, `0`, `empty`)
